principles.statement: All runtime access is immutable and query-only
principles.rationale: The tool is a retrieval surface, never a second writer
principles.enforcement: Open SQLite with mode=ro and query_only; expose no mutation command

principles.statement: Stale evidence is a hard failure
principles.enforcement: Require projection metadata to match the configured ledger watermark when supplied

principles.rationale: Bounded output improves privacy, latency, and downstream synthesis
principles.enforcement: Cap hits and snippets; emit stable source IDs

principles.statement: Repository artifacts contain synthetic data only
principles.rationale: The public project must never leak personal vault content
principles.enforcement: Secret scan, privacy tests, ignore runtime state and fixtures policy
